claim: Finds byte-for-byte duplicate media with complete SHA-256 hashes.
sandbox: fresh browser context; upload shipped duplicate JPEG fixtures; compare exported hashes with Node complete SHA-256 digests

claim: Suggests visually close photos captured within 30 seconds without calling them duplicates.
sandbox: synthetic images; assert inclusion at exactly 30 seconds, exclusion at 31 seconds, and cautious classification

claim: Exports a CSV move plan without changing originals.
sandbox: shipped duplicate fixtures; parse download headers, quoted rows, group type, reason, and full hash; compare source digest before and after

claim: Saves the review workspace on this device across reloads.
sandbox: fresh browser context; make decisions; reload and assert the saved review count

claim: The installed app reopens offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh context; open demo, make a decision, wait for worker control, go offline, reload, and assert sample data, previews, banner, and decision

claim: Free review data stays in the browser and contacts no other website or service.
sandbox: fresh demo context; record every request during review decisions; assert only the product origin

claim: The four-file sample uses a separate demo workspace that can be reset or discarded without changing real work.
sandbox: seed a real decision; enter demo; assert four sample files and two groups; reset, leave, and assert the real decision remains

claim: The free product accepts up to 750 supported files and rejects 751 before scanning.
sandbox: 750 and 751 in-memory supported video files; assert boundary behavior without file reads

claim: Exports and restores a JSON workspace backup in the browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context; decide, download backup, start a new scan, restore backup, and assert decision returns

claim: A validated one-time US$12 Archive pass lets a licensed user scan folders above the 750-file free limit.
where: landing pricing, license dialog, README, terms
sandbox: recorded valid license response; follow the product checkout redirect and assert Photo Cull Review, USD, US$12 subtotal and total; then scan 751 files through the browser

claim: Hashes videos as streams for exact-copy matching without generating video previews.
sandbox: stream-only video doubles whose arrayBuffer throws; assert exact group with no thumbnail or visual hash

claim: With a supplied license token, verification is the app's only cross-origin runtime request.
sandbox: fresh browser context; route the verification fixture; record requests and assert the sole cross-origin URL is the verify endpoint

claim: Explains exact-copy and likely-burst groups before you decide.
sandbox: demo sample; open both groups and assert complete-hash evidence and cautious camera-time/visual evidence

claim: Uses embedded JPEG camera capture time for burst suggestions, never file modification time.
sandbox: synthetic records with copied-file modification times; assert grouping uses only embedded capture times

claim: Accepts JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, MP4, MOV, M4V, and WebM files.
sandbox: in-memory files for every documented MIME type plus unsupported text; assert all documented types are selected and text is skipped

claim: Images show local previews.
sandbox: demo sample; assert each displayed image candidate has a local preview image

claim: CSV move plans and JSON workspace backups are available without an Archive pass.
sandbox: fresh unlicensed context; export CSV and JSON, then parse path and complete hash fields

claim: No server, account, or API key is required for free review.
sandbox: fresh context with empty cookies and storage; upload shipped fixtures and assert a review starts with no account/key request

claim: A provided license token stays in browser storage, and New scan clears the saved review workspace.
sandbox: recorded valid license response; inspect local token, make a real workspace, choose New scan, reload, and assert empty workspace

claim: The app includes no ads, analytics, tracking pixels, third-party fonts, or runtime scripts.
sandbox: record requests and inspect storage across home, demo, and legal routes; assert only same-origin resources and no tracking storage

claim: Sociobot/Dodo is the merchant of record, and a refunded license is inactive.
sandbox: recorded revoked verification response; assert inactive state, documented merchant/refund copy, and hosted checkout URL
